title: Qualitative bifurcation diagram for Grad-Shafranov type equations
summary: We study the qualitative behavior of solutions of Grad-Shafranov type equations arising in plasma physics with general differential operators and general nonlinearities. In particular, we extend recent estimates about threshold values for uniqueness, monotonicity and non-existence of the free boundary. The argument is based on a refined spectral analysis for weighted non-local problems together with comparison techniques and level set analysis.
